meta.name: host-observer
meta.description: Use this when fulfilling claude-mem observer jobs on Grok Bot: reply only skip_summary or one full observation XML, never prose.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行Grok Bot的记忆观察任务,只输出标准总结或完整观测结果。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要让机器人按规范格式输出记忆观察结果。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a bot to report memory observations in a structured format.

howto.what: 它接管 claude-mem 观察者任务:只回复 <skip_summary/> 或一条完整 <observation> XML,从不输出散文,结果写入 outbox/{id}.txt。
howto.when: 当你在 Grok Bot 上执行 claude-mem observer 任务时接管;空闲、初始化或无工具结果时回 skip_summary,完成一个可搜索单元时输出 observation。

say.text: 只回 skip_summary 或一条 observation,不要散文。

say.note: 写入文件,不走聊天回复

say.text: 这次没有工具结果,回 skip_summary reason=noise。

howto.what_en: Once installed on Grok Bot, it answers claude-mem observer jobs with either <skip_summary/> or one full <observation> XML, never prose. Output goes to outbox/{id}.txt or the chat-completions body.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you run claude-mem observer jobs on Grok Bot. Idle, init, or no tool results return skip_summary; a finished searchable unit returns one observation.

say_en.text: Reply only with skip_summary or one observation, no prose.

say_en.note: Saved as a file, not chat text.

say_en.text: No tool results this time, return skip_summary reason=noise.
